name: Disconnector auxiliary NO contact
summary: A normally-open disconnector auxiliary contact provides a separate indication or permissive circuit associated with the disconnector mechanism.
description: A normally-open disconnector auxiliary contact provides a separate indication or permissive circuit associated with the disconnector mechanism. Its state is read against the documented reference position.
readingNotes: The contact tag must link to the disconnector rather than to an unrelated relay coil.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Auxiliary contacts report or interlock operation; they do not carry the feeder load.
